title: Find the full names of members who paid their dues before October 1, 2019 a
question: Find the full names of members who paid their dues before October 1, 2019 and are from Illinois, but exclude those majoring in 'Business'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_029"
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T3 ON T1."XCL_041" = T3."XCL_043"
LEFT JOIN major AS T4 ON T1."XCL_042" = T4."XCL_030"
WHERE T2."XCL_027" = 'Dues'
  AND T2."XCL_025" < '2019-10-01'
  AND T3."XCL_047" = 'Illinois'
  AND (T4."XCL_031" IS NULL OR T4."XCL_031" != 'Business')
